mutations.label: check-timing: each file goes to the worker that is free first
mutations.only: ^(?:the order a file list is run in decides how long the slowest worker takes)$

mutations.label: check-timing: a run is joined only to a check whose window holds it
mutations.only: ^(?:a run no check holds is said as unjoined, and a contended check is said as contended)$

mutations.label: check-timing: red then green counts only when the tree did not change between
mutations.only: ^(?:a tree that went red and then green with nothing changed is counted, and a fix between them is not)$
